profile.headline: Sr. Software Development Engineer
profile.summary: I'm an enthusiastic software developer for 10 years. I've worked from e-commerce startups to a multi-national cloud platform, dealing with different software languages and markets in order to meet their customers' demands. I love to learn and study new things, especially when I can apply and test this knowledge. BSc Computer Science.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Working as a Software Development Engineer for the AWS Support organization, building and maintaining the tooling that is used daily by AWS customers and AWS support teams that help them.
It is powered by our native AWS technologies such as Lambda, DynamoDB, S3.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the newer version of the web app for the public-facing, food delivery system of the company. We've built a React-based online food delivery web application.

Also launched the PWA version compatible with both Android and iOS of the same food delivery system to focus on low-end and budget smartphones for customers that either didn't want to or could not install their respective native mobile OS versions.

Lastly, our team was also responsible for updates on the home/institutional page as well as some of the promotional campaigns embedded in them.

positions.title: Frontend Software Architect
positions.description:
Working at the Rapid Prototype Team, to deliver fast production-ready projects in Angular 4. Based on daily iterations like agile development to meet client expectations.

Most of the projects were updates to legacy systems to improve UI, UX and adding new customer features with our in-house library of components - developed and maintained by our team.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Worked at the Smartphones Platform Unit (Kiwi) as a front-end and back-end developer. My team is responsible for a Backend-as-a-Service Smartphone Platform that provides and supports many common features to all Apps developed by Movile, such as authentication, monetization, analytics, users and devices management, notifications, feedback and support, media tracking, plugins driven by events, remote configuration and A/B testing.
We applied recent technologies to support these features, dealing with a great amount of data on a highly distributed solution.

Some of the front-end technologies: AngularJS, ECMAScript 2015 (ES6), Babel, Less, Bootstrap, HTML5, Node.js, Bower, Gulp, npm/yarn.
And the back-end ones: Java 8, Spring Framework, Kotlin, Jetty, Apache Cassandra, PostgresSQL, Redis
AWS products used by the platform: DynamoDB, EC2, S3, Kinesis, SQS, ElasticSearch, CloudWatch Tests with JUnit and Mockito.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on an e-commerce platform, dealing with both front-end and back-end software development.
Developed a platform using AngularJS, Spring MVC Framework and some AWS products (S3, Cloud Search).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked mainly on an existing distributed platform of mobile content which delivers millions of messages per day (SMS, MMS) to Brazil and Latin America.

Also developed an internal REST system for authorization management of mobile numbers. It was mainly used by our mobile billing and messaging systems.

positions.title: Software Developer Trainee
positions.description:
Got in touch with Java EE projects, HTTP protocol for mobile carrier integrations and own systems communications, SQL server environment (Microsoft SQL), Git and SVN as version control systems.

Was coordinated to migrate a legacy messaging system to the current one (Java EE).

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services
